body.prompt: Late at night in a dark small Seoul apartment bedroom, a Korean office worker in his early forties, short black hair, thin metal glasses, white shirt and navy tie, glasses on the bedside table, lies on his back in bed wide awake staring at the ceiling, faint cold blue light from the window across his face. Painterly cinematic oil-painting look with fine film grain, a present-day Korean office scene painted in a Renaissance chiaroscuro manner, warm amber key light against deep navy shadows, faces and hands large, clearly lit and readable, simple uncluttered background, muted bronze, umber and navy palette, not cartoonish. Vertical 9:16 frame, main action in the middle of the frame, calm darker empty space in the top quarter. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no readable screens, no logos, no watermark.
